name: Anime Town Bossier City
blurb: A stop of the Anime Town multi-city tour at the Bossier City Civic Center, in the Shreveport-Bossier area of Louisiana.
notes: The organizer brands this edition 'Anime Town Louisiana' on its own site (nav label 'LOUISIANA', URL path /louisiana, heading 'ANIME TOWN LOUSIANA' [sic]) even though the venue is in Bossier City; kept the given id/name since Bossier City is the actual host city, matching how the other Anime Town files are named. Own page ('APRIL 10TH-12TH, 2026 Bossier City Civic Center... Bossier City Civic Center. 620 Benton Road, Bossier City, LA 71111') shows an edition that already concluded before this check (2026-10-05); the brand's main homepage lists this city's next date as 'TBD', so no 2027 edition is announced yet. Part of the multi-city Anime Town tour — see the Greenville, Huntsville, Biloxi and Pensacola files for the other stops.
